name: Promptfoo GitHub Action
summary: GitHub Action for running Promptfoo prompt, agent and RAG tests and red-team scans in CI.
description: Evaluates prompts when monitored files change; on pull requests it posts a summary comment with pass/fail counts and, if sharing is enabled, a Promptfoo web-viewer link. Inputs include config, prompts, provider API keys, promptfoo-version and no-share.
